entries.claim: `HERE` calls `fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)`, but this new module never imports `fileURLToPath` from `node:url`.
entries.failure_scenario: Every invocation of `planning.mjs` statically imports `planning/core.mjs`; evaluating core throws `ReferenceError: fileURLToPath is not defined` while initializing `HERE`, before dispatch or the catch-all can produce an `ok:false` envelope. Consequently all planning commands fail at startup.

counter_evidence.note: Line 25 is `import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';` - the exact import the finding says is absent. HERE is at core.mjs:93, not :36. `node cadence-core/bin/planning.mjs status` exits 0 and returns its envelope, so no ReferenceError is thrown at module evaluation. The reviewer read a NARROWED artifact with verbatim-moved lines and line numbers stripped, so the import block was not in what it saw.
